page.title: Your kitchen
page.purpose: Keep what the person has and how they cook in one place: optional dated inventory grouped by storage, equipment chosen through tiles and a kitchen scene, and the preferences planning relies on.

priorities.statement: On hand lists what is in the fridge, freezer, and pantry with honest amounts — exact, estimated, qualitative, out, or not set — and when each was last checked.
Use soon items lead to meals that use them without claiming there is enough.
Equipment tiles are the complete way to choose appliances, cookware, and tools; the kitchen scene reflects the selection and never decides it.
Selecting equipment is immediate and free, and removing it previews affected future meals.
Preferences keep required rules separate from dislikes and soft priorities, and a required-rule change previews its conflicts.
Inventory is optional: Skip inventory or Track only staples keeps planning useful.

states.description: The On hand tab with inventory grouped by storage and the use-soon, equipment, and preference panels on wide screens.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
A search or filter matched nothing; the query stays visible and Reset filters is offered.
No inventory is recorded; Add ingredient, Skip inventory, and Track only staples are offered.
Items flagged Use soon lead the page with Find meals.
The Equipment tab: the kitchen scene beside the tiles on desktop, a short scene above the category selector and two-column tiles on phones.
No equipment is selected; this is valid and assembly or ready-to-eat meals are suggested.
Every item is selected; tiles stay accurate and the scene shows a bounded subset or a More selected label.
An appliance's details: count, functions, capacity, and notes.
Removing an appliance previews affected future meal methods and alternatives.
A scene layer is missing; the tiles remain the accurate, complete interface.
The Preferences tab: Food rules, Household and servings, Time and effort, Variety and favourites, Planning routine, Nutrition targets and supplements, Shopping preferences.
A required-rule change previews conflicts with future plans before it applies.

claims.statement: Add ingredient is the one filled primary action on On hand.
Qualitative, estimated, exact, out, and not-set amounts read differently, and no confidence percentage is shown.
Available never implies a measured quantity or food-safety certification.
Last checked reflects recorded evidence and is not refreshed by opening the page.
Use soon leads to Find meals, which keeps uncertain quantities uncertain.
An empty inventory offers Skip inventory and Track only staples, and planning stays usable.
Every scene marker's information and action is also reachable from the tiles and their details.
A scene marker opens details and never silently removes equipment; markers have 44 px hit areas and hide on phones when they would overlap.
Appliances, Cookware, and Tools stay visible and reachable on phones.
Selecting nothing is valid and says assembly or ready-to-eat meals will be suggested.
With a missing scene layer, the tiles still show the accurate selection.
Removing equipment previews affected future methods before applying.
A required-rule change previews conflicts with future plans; history is untouched.
On phones inventory rows become cards with the name above the amount, never a sideways-scrolling table.
Tabs, storage filters, rows and their menus, tiles, markers, and categories are keyboard reachable.
Selecting a tile fades the matching scene layer without moving controls or resetting scroll; with reduced motion the change is instant.
The page never scrolls sideways; the table reflows to card rows.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
